title: •Order 66
caption: •Kill Them Immediately (V)
game_text: Deploy on Sidious. If with {ovs} Expand The Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an {episode1} Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.
